basic_profile.bio: A Brazilian economics student with a passion for global financial markets. Currently halfway through a degree at a top university, aiming to break into the finance scene in the USA or UK. Interested in gaming and comedy, often found browsing PS5Shipping or indulging in humor on MasterofNone. Living in São Paulo, typically online during late evenings after classes. Single but focused on career advancement, has been a Reddit member for 7 years.
